summary: A deacon or deaconess describes the job as being ready to visit the sick and go where help is needed.
realLife: A deaconess said deacons are expected to visit the sick and serve the community, and deaconesses also comfort families who have lost someone.
sources: Orlando Memory, deaconess oral history interview: https://orlandomemory.org/people/deaconess-lillian-lancaster-mt-zion-missionary-baptist-institutional-church-oral-history-interview/
inGame: needs: a congregation role record and a visit event; sickness itself is carried by an illness record

turns.summary: The deacon arrives the day the news comes.
turns.writesBack: tie warms; the illness is shared knowledge

turns.summary: A card and a call stand in for a visit.
The deacon learns of the illness a week late.
